source_candidates.name: Football-Data.co.uk SP1
source_candidates.historical: Four cached La Liga season sheets (shots and Bet365 odds)
source_candidates.notes: Provides results, shots and odds but not xG or player availability. It is the production results source, not an optional feature source.

source_candidates.name: Understat
source_candidates.historical: Team and player xG by match from 2014/15 onward
source_candidates.redistribution: no official API; respect site terms and rate limits
source_candidates.notes: A plausible historical xG source, but no local timestamped extract is committed. Retrieval requires a scraper, availability timestamps are not published, and post-match xG must be lagged before kickoff. Do not treat it as configured until an extract with available_at exists.

source_candidates.name: FBref / StatsBomb data
source_candidates.historical: Selected competitions and seasons; not a complete La Liga archive
source_candidates.redistribution: site terms; StatsBomb open data has its own licence
source_candidates.notes: Coverage is incomplete for the cached seasons and access is not a stable API. Not integrated, so no coverage is claimed.

source_candidates.name: API-Football (xG)
source_candidates.historical: xG availability depends on plan/league; free tier has no reliable xG
source_candidates.notes: The fixture-discovery integration only uses the fixtures endpoint. Historical xG on the free plan is not assumed; a paid plan and a verified extract would be required before enabling the xG group.

source_candidates.name: API-Football (injuries/lineups)
source_candidates.historical: Current injuries and lineups; historical snapshots require paid access
source_candidates.notes: Availability must be timestamped before kickoff. The free plan and the fixture provider do not provide a historical availability archive.

source_candidates.name: Transfermarkt
source_candidates.historical: Injury histories, but publication timestamps are not an API field
source_candidates.notes: Without a reliable publication timestamp, using it would risk post-kickoff information leakage. Not integrated.

source_candidates.name: Local xG history extract
source_candidates.notes: Place a legitimate, timestamped extract at data/raw/xg_history.csv to enable the optional xG group. When absent, the group is unavailable.

source_candidates.name: Local player-availability extract
source_candidates.notes: Place a legitimate, timestamped extract at data/raw/player_availability.csv to enable the availability group. When absent, it is unavailable.

findings.message: No timestamped historical xG extract is present. The xG feature group is unavailable and the production model is unchanged.
No timestamped player-availability extract is present. The availability feature group is unavailable and no values are fabricated.

notes: A source is only 'available' when a local timestamped extract exists.
Coverage is measured from that extract; no external provider coverage is claimed.
Timestamps before kickoff are required; post-match xG is lagged by the loader.
